subject: Problem with my linen shirt order
body: Hi, I picked up a linen shirt from your Suzhou Industrial Park store a few days ago and only opened it properly last night. The box was already squashed and partly torn when I got it home, and now that I've looked at the shirt there's a problem with it too. I'm pretty disappointed, especially since it wasn't cheap. Can you let me know what I can do about this? I still have the receipt and the packaging.
